subject: Priority lane bundling & exit clause — commercial terms
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@stellardata.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — follow-up on response lane pricing

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Stellar's infra team likes the latency characteristics. Procurement asked me to confirm whether you can bundle a 24/7 priority lane with a 99.95% uptime SLA for our production workload, and whether there's a short-form exit clause we can rely on if the pilot doesn't meet expected throughput.

High-level asks:
- Price for Priority Lane (reserved capacity) for 6 months
- Response times: 15 min P1 / 4 hours P2
- Exit clause: 30-day wind-down with data export guarantees

Can you send a short commercial that we can share with legal/procurement?

Best,
Julia
Julia Park
Director of Platform Engineering
Stellar Data
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Julia Park <julia@stellardata.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — follow-up on response lane pricing

Hi Julia — great to hear the demo landed well. Attached is a short commercial outline and a proposed SLA with an exit clause redline (Priority-Lane-Offer-v3.pdf, SLA-exit-clause-redline.docx).

Quick summary here:
- Priority Lane (reserved) for 6 months: $45k/month, includes 24/7 triage + 15 min P1 response (phone) / 4 hr P2 (ticket).
- Uptime target: 99.95% per month with credits on a sliding scale (0.5% credit per 0.01% below target, capped at 50%).
- Exit option: 30-day wind-down; Redwood will provide an export bundle and a short transition support block (5 engineer-days) to help with cache purge and data handoff.

Marking as tentative — cc'ing Karthik to confirm discount flexibility if Stellar commits to a 12-month renewal at the end of the pilot.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Priority lane commercial — internal pricing check

Looping Laura for approval on a concession. Notes:
- Standard list for this pack is $55k/mo.
- We can offer $45k/mo for a 6-month pilot but need a conditional clause: if Stellar signs a 12-month commit within 60 days after pilot, we hold price and apply a 10% rebate on pilot spend.
- The exit clause compromise: keep 30-day wind-down but exclude bespoke model fine-tune artifacts from export guarantee (IP caveat).

Laura — ok to proceed with the conditional rebate and IP carve-out?

-Karthik
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-04T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Priority lane commercial — internal pricing check

Agree to the conditional rebate, but tighten the export SLA:
- 7 business days for raw logs and customer-owned prompts, 15 business days for model artifacts (where applicable)
- Add a standard non-disparagement clause and remove the open-ended engineer-days liability — cap to 5 days as proposed

Karthik/Dylan, push that back to Julia and procurement. We should keep the rebate offer limited to one-time application per account.

-Laura
VP, Sales Operations
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Julia Park <julia@stellardata.com>, Mark Chen <procurement@stellardata.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-05T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Updated commercial and exit terms for Priority Lane (v3)

Hi Julia / Mark — thanks for the patience. Per internal approvals we've updated the offer: see attached Priority-Lane-Offer-v3.pdf and SLA-exit-clause-redline.docx. Highlights:
- Pilot pricing: $45k/month for 6 months (Priority Lane reserved capacity).
- Conditional rebate: 10% credit applied to pilot billing if Stellar executes a 12-month renewal within 60 days after pilot completion (one-time, non-stackable).
- Response SLAs: 15 min P1 phone, 4 hr P2 ticketing; escalation roster included in appendix.
- Export & wind-down: 30-day wind-down with 7 business days for logs/prompt export, 15 business days for model artifacts; Redwood excludes proprietary fine-tune artifacts created by Stellar during the pilot (recommendation: if you need full artifact escrow, we can discuss a separate arrangement).

Questions for procurement: any required PO terms, or standard PO + net-30 acceptable?

If this looks ok I can loop legal to start a short SOW and schedule a kickoff on the 14th.

Cheers,
Dylan
From: Mark Chen <procurement@stellardata.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Julia Park <julia@stellardata.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated commercial and exit terms for Priority Lane (v3)

Dylan — thanks for the clarity. A couple small asks from procurement/legal before we sign:
1) Can the export SLA for model artifacts be shortened to 10 business days? We have an internal requirement for faster handoff.
2) For the IP carve-out: can you add a clause that Redwood will provide a certified audit log showing what artifacts were excluded and why?
3) PO terms: Standard PO + net-30 is fine, but we need Redwood to accept our standard MFN clause in the SOW (we'll share redlines).

If you can accommodate artifact export to 10 business days and the certified audit log, we can move to SOW execution next week.

-Mark
Procurement Manager
Stellar Data
